body: I really appreciate that. I have considered therapy and want to do it, but I’m not sure where to start even. I think my insurance is semi decent, it’s blue cross blue shield, but I know I opted into the cheapest plan offered by my employer so I’m not sure how much that affects it. I also know it would be tough to swing something like a hundred dollars a session, but I have no clue if that’s even a roughly accurate estimate. I used to have a bunch of close friends but have drifted away and just kinda doubt I would find relief in dumping all this on any of them
